text:
Munich’s median asking rent stands at 23.23 €/m², the highest of the 37‑city sample and up 3.0 % year‑on‑year, with a five‑year gain of 26.9 %. The inter‑quartile range runs from 20.0 €/m² to 26.94 €/m², and a 60 m² unit costs about 1,394 € per month.  

The market remains tight: average days on market are 22 days, only 34 % of listings are let within a week and vacancy sits at 1.4 %. Rent‑burden for two residents is 21.9 %, while asking rents are roughly 80 % above existing census rents of 12.89 €/m².  

A model estimate forecasts the median asking rent at 24.44 €/m² in 12 months, ranging between 23.71 €/m² and 24.95 €/m², implying a 5.2 % rise.
